title: [PD] Support KV transfer with mooncake
body:

## Motivation

See #4654 #4655 
Mooncake transfer engine is a high-performance, zero-copy data transfer library. To achieve efficient PD disaggregation, mooncake team wants to adopt mooncake transfer engine as the transport layer.

### Usage
Know how to install mooncake transfer engine [here](https://github.com/kvcache-ai/Mooncake/blob/main/doc/en/build.md). We provide a new [adaptor](https://github.com/kvcache-ai/Mooncake/commit/db5929edd128e9df787e664236bc71446adcdc02) and new [interface](https://github.com/kvcache-ai/Mooncake/commit/fec09ff52d22c8e647bd90e13a0ac69acc9208e2) for using transfer engine in SGLang. Note that current implementation is just a prototype.

SGLang PD disaggregation: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/4880#issuecomment-2775457846

### Known Limitations:

1. Failure handling is currently missing.
2. We assume each server only has one SGLang instance, which means it doesn't support multiple P/D instances located on one server at the same time.
3. If GDR is not supported, it should fall back to double buffering for data copies (we don't implement it now).
4. The current implementation relies on ETCD for coordination. We plan to replace this with implementing the bootstrap server in conn.py.

CC: @james0zan @ShangmingCai @XucSh @alogfans @ByronHsu @zhyncs 


## Modifications

### Workflow:
1. KVManager init MooncakeTransferEngine
    1. Registering all GPU addresses into RDMA via KVArgs
    2. Initialize a map (request_pool: RequestPoolType) from bootstrap_room to metadata (kv_indices/aux_token)
    3. Add a zmq server bound to a specific port. For KVSender/Receiver, there is a dedicated thread for polling messages from KVSender.
2. KVSender kvsend: 
    1. Add [bootstrap_room: [kv_indices, aux_token]] to request_pool.
3. KVReceiver init: Add [bootstrap_room: [kv_indices, aux_token]] to request_pool. Send metadata (bootstrap_room, kv_data_ptrs, aux_data_ptrs...) to KVSender via zmq, as a Start for KVSender prefill thread
4. KVSender prefill thread
    1. Recv metadata from KVReceiver (bootstrap_room, kv_data_ptrs, aux_data_ptrs...) via zmq
    2. Perform GDR-based RDMA Write using mooncake transferSync
    3. Send the bootstrap_room and Done signal to KVReceiver
5. KVReceiver decode thread
    1. Recv bootstrap_room from KVSender
    2. Pop above bootstrap_room in request_pool
